$comment: Texas appraisal district bulk-data directory. Catalogued 15 Aug 2026.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Texas has no state-published parcel file. 254 districts
publish separately, in four different layouts, and nobody has published a
directory of where. Building one is a moat; guessing at one is a liability.
HOW TO READ `confidence`:
verified   the data page was fetched and the links below were read off it
indexed    the page is known to exist but could not be rendered server-side
(JavaScript portal or bot-blocking). Needs a real browser.
not_found  no public data page located. Treat as public-information-request.
A GUESSED URL IS WORSE THAN A MISSING ONE, because a scraper gets built
against it. Nothing in `files` was constructed by pattern; every entry was
read from a page. HEAD-check before wiring a downloader anyway — see
scripts/tx/fetch.sh, which does exactly that and refuses on a redirect to
an HTML error page.
cad_id is the Comptroller's 3-digit county code (001 Anderson .. 254 Zavala),
which is also the prefix of an EARS filename. Backfilled 16 Aug from
comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/resources/county-codes.php and cross-checked against
Travis CAD's own EARS filename (227EARS...). It is NOT derived by alphabetising
county names: the Comptroller sorts 'El Paso' as if the space were absent, so
Ellis is 070 and El Paso is 071, and a naive sort reverses them.
cad_id sits in the tx_parcels PRIMARY KEY. A wrong code does not error — it
silently files a whole district's parcels under another county.
Canonical copy: lib/tx/counties.js.
FILENAME STABILITY. Only El Paso and Grayson use paths that do not change
between rolls, so only those two can be polled on a schedule by URL. Everywhere
else the filename embeds a date or supplement number and the listing page must
be re-parsed each run.

`in_season` (19 Oct 2026): did the district publish THIS year's values in a bulk file before the 15 May protest deadline in 2026? A district that only publishes its July certified roll cannot be served in season (we do not attend hearings, so the kit is the whole case). `load_with` names the overlay for districts whose in-season file lacks neighborhood codes. See TX_In_Season_Data_33_Districts_2026-10-19.md.

formats.PACS: Harris Govern / True Automation. Fixed-width, ~19 files, versioned layout 8.0.x (current 8.0.33/8.0.34). Roughly two-thirds of Texas. ONE PARSER COVERS ALL OF THESE.
formats.HCAD: Harris County's own schema. Tab-delimited ASCII, zipped. Fully documented codebook.
formats.ORION: Tyler Technologies Orion. Filenames literally contain 'Orion'. Fort Bend and Hays.
formats.ISW: Interactive Software / Southwest Data Solutions. Parker, Midland, Tom Green, Henderson.
formats.EARS: The Comptroller submission format itself. Only Travis publishes it. Documented in Form 96-1051.
formats.TAB_DELIM: Tab-delimited .tab files with header rows on most members (externalnal.tab, externalbld.tab, externalland.tab). Bell. NOT PACS despite Bell publishing a PACS layout document — verified by opening the archive 16 Aug. Needs its own parser; the header rows make it self-describing, so it is easier than PACS, just different.

districts.notes: Best-documented large district, and the ONLY one publishing raw EARS. Its public posting of EARS is the precedent cited in our request to the Comptroller. Also publishes JSON, which is the cheapest possible parser validation target. RE-READ 17 Sept 2026: the page carries THREE files this entry did not have - the 2026 EARS submission (26 Aug), a 2026 SUPPLEMENTAL roll export (Supp 334) and a supplemental JSON (Supp 2, 29 Aug). LOAD THE CERTIFIED SUPP 0, NOT THE SUPPLEMENT: the certified roll is the legal snapshot the protest is against, and El Paso taught the same lesson in reverse - its header reads "As of Supplement" and is fresher than the July certification, so the two districts are NOT directly comparable without saying which snapshot each came from. Layout is 8.0.33, already in VALIDATED_EXPORT_VERSIONS via Tarrant, and load.mjs selects residential by stateCategory()==='A' rather than a per-district class list - so this district should need NO new code. NOT REACHABLE from the agent sandbox: traviscad.org is denied at the egress gateway in both the cloud container and the device VM (403 on CONNECT), so the zip has to be downloaded on the Mac. UPDATE 3 Oct 2026: traviscad.org now answers from the device VM, and the certified Supp 0 (557,228,168 bytes, sha256 62d0d1cd22b03f31db8d3986160eb181c5d00044df98a303fce9e17a44e9aa02) was downloaded there. LOADED 3 Oct 2026. Two things were new: (1) the zip uses the LEGACY SHORT MEMBER NAMES - PROP.TXT, IMP_DET.TXT, LAND_DET.TXT, APPR_HDR.TXT - with the identical 8.0.0.33 record lengths (9922/622/199), handled by LEGACY_MEMBER in load.mjs; (2) the dwelling is coded by storey (1ST 1st Floor, 2ND 2nd Floor, 3RD, 1/2 Half Floor), which no pattern matched, while 095 HVAC RESIDENTIAL matched RESID and was the only living area - fixed in lib/tx/pacs.js. situs_city is blank on ~44% of rows (28,134 of a 50,000-row sample carried one); situs_zip is populated on every residential row sampled.

districts.notes: RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026. Free, unauthenticated, direct URLs; 2027 404s so 2026 is current. ASCII TAB-DELIMITED with header rows per HCAD Import_Instructions — third-party repos calling it fixed-width describe older vintages. Bespoke schema, 13-digit acct, needs its own parser. Fields: heat_ar, date_erected, land_val, tot_mkt_val, tot_appr_val, Neighborhood_Code, state_class, qa_cd. NO condition code and NO explicit cap-loss field — a Cap_acct flag exists and cap loss is PROBABLY market minus appraised, but HCAD publishes no definition, so verify empirically before relying on it. UNIQUELY ships arb_protest_real.txt and arb_hearings_real.txt: real per-account protest and hearing OUTCOMES, which nobody else publishes. Refresh cadence in-season is UNKNOWN and is the open question that decides whether Harris works during Apr-May.

districts.notes: RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026. The 15 Aug entry said "unknown format / likely paid" and BOTH were wrong: it is free, no registration, no published licence or redistribution restriction. NOT PACS — in-house CAMA called MARS on SQL Server. Use the comma-delimited relational set, not the fixed roll: the fixed roll has no year built, no neighborhood code and no class code. CSV set carries NBHD_CD, SPTD_CD, BLDG_CLASS_DESC, TOT_LIVING_AREA_SF, YR_BUILT and CAPPED_HS_AMT (a real explicit cap-loss field, better than Harris). districts.notes: RESOLVED 8 Sept 2026, and the 15 Aug entry was out of date. TAD moved off Aumentum to TRUE PRODIGY for the 2026 roll and now emits a PACS-family fixed-width export with a published layout (Legacy 8.0.33) — the El Paso parser should largely carry over. ~713 MB. The old data-downloads.php URL is Cloudflare-blocked; the extensionless path works. Legacy PropertyData files are refreshed continuously (so they exist during the Apr-May window) but carry NO neighborhood code and NO class code — unusable for comps. ARB mail goes to its own PO Box 185519, Fort Worth 76181, NOT the district. LAYOUT VERIFIED 9 Sept 2026 against scripts/tx/pacs_8_0_34.json, field by field: 467 byte ranges are identical between 8.0.33 and 8.0.34, and ALL 12 FIELDS load.mjs ACTUALLY READS sit at identical offsets (prop_id 1-12, situs_street 1050-1099, abs_subdv_cd 1676-1685, market_value 4214-4227, nhs_cap_loss 9068-9082, imprv_det_area 94-108 and yr_built 86-89 in the detail file, appraised_value 404-418 in the entity file). The two versions differ ONLY in naming: 8.0.33 carves named fields out of regions 8.0.34 leaves as `filler` (ownership_pct, mineral_lease_id) and the exemption block was renamed (df_* -> fdhs_*, bpp_ex_* -> 145b_*). No net shift anywhere. THE EXISTING LOADER PARSES TARRANT UNCHANGED. Note the first diff is a name-vs-name comparison trap: comparing field NAMES reports "0 shifted" for the wrong reason, because 22 ranges are renames. Compare BYTE RANGES.

districts.notes: RESOLVED 20 Sept 2026 IN A BROWSER. The data-downloads page is a Prodigy single-page app that serves an empty shell to every non-browser fetch, and denton.prodigycad.com is denied at the agent egress gateway, so neither WebFetch nor curl could see it. A real browser renders it: the year sections are accordions, and 2026 opens to six certified extracts plus an appraisal export layout. FREE, no login. THE FILES ARE ON A DIFFERENT HOST, dentoncad.net, which is also denied at the gateway - so the download is a human step. WALKED THE OPEN APACHE INDEX at /data/_uploaded/files/datafiles/, which lists more than the portal page links. THE FILE IS "2026 CERTIFIED DATA - REAL.zip", 781 MB, dated 27 July 2026. ** THE EXPORT DECLARES 8.0.0.33, WHICH IS ALREADY VALIDATED - IT LOADS UNCHANGED. ** Verified 20 Sept from the archive’s own APPRAISAL_HEADER.TXT: TP version 8.1.33.23, export_version 8.0.0.33, appraisal year 2026, district Denton. The LAYOUT DOCUMENT is titled TP Legacy 8.0.32 and dated Feb 2026 - that is the spec sheet’s version, NOT the export’s, and reading the filename as the export version led to a wrong call that this file would be refused. THE HEADER IS THE AUTHORITY, not the layout’s title. Diffed 8.0.32 against pacs_8_0_34.json independently anyway: ZERO fields moved across all eight sections, and all 27 offsets load.mjs reads are identical. Differences are naming only - fdhs_* became df_*, 145b_* became bpp_ex_*, situs_street_sufx became situs_street_suffix, PACS Version became TP Version, and Imprv_det_* gained a capital I. The parser reads by OFFSET, so none of that matters. A WARNING FROM THIS DIFF: comparing the two layouts BY POSITION reports 439 shifted fields in APPRAISAL_INFO, all spurious, because 8.0.34 lists two filler rows 8.0.32 omits and every later pair is then misaligned. Compare by NAME on byte ranges. The Tarrant note warns about the opposite trap; both are real. The directory also holds Legacy8.0.30 and a PublicJSON layout. NO PRELIMINARY ROLL: the 2026 directory carries only certified extracts, so unlike Montgomery this district gives us nothing in season.

hearing_outcome_publishers.$comment: Free, account-level, historical OUTCOMES data — initial vs final value per account. This is how the expected-reduction model gets built, and how the invented avgSavings numbers on 69 city pages get replaced with sourced ones. Harris additionally tags each row with Agent_Code, which identifies the firm, so competitor performance is measurable from public data.
